Prepare, verify, meet

Eligible in your state Affidavit notarization
Today
Member view

Your affidavit is eligible for remote notarization. Bring your government ID and join from a quiet, well-lit place.

Verify

ID check, knowledge-based authentication, camera readiness, and signer consent are grouped before the live session.

Session

The app shows the selected time, notary join button, waiting room status, and escalation path if the member is late.

Receipt

After completion, the member can download the notarized file, view audit details, and send a copy to HFCU staff.
